blocks.x: Applied AI & GenAI inside Precision Agriculture & Agronomy: the operating realities we design for, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Precision agriculture converts sensing into input savings and yield: soil/weather/crop telemetry, variable-rate practice, agronomy models and machine orchestration. The unit economics are per-hectare — and they clear investment hurdles when engineered honestly.

At Agriculture & Food Systems level this capability reads as: field-grounded recommendations with treatment citations for advisors (advisory coverage extended per agronomist). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The rhythm is fixed on purpose: progress becomes visible from week one, not after the first steering meeting. Weeks 1–2 belong to measurement: the baseline metric is captured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 run a bounded pilot — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — steered by a control owner on your side. Weeks 9–12 convert the pilot into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, and close with a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses a gate is stopped or redirected on the record.
